title: GET STARTED
subtitle: Three steps to your first paid search.

banner.mainnet: MAINNET — funding here uses real USDC.
banner.testnet: TESTNET — funds here have no real value.

wallet.title: Connect your wallet
wallet.description: Stellar Search pays for each result with a small USDC micropayment (x402) — connect Freighter to get started.

trustline.title: Add a USDC trustline
trustline.description: Stellar accounts need an explicit trustline before they can hold an issued asset like USDC. Open Freighter → Manage Assets → Add Asset with the issuer below.

payment.title: Fund your balance
payment.description: Each search settles {{amount}} USDC on completion — fund your trustline with at least that much to run your first paid query.
